about_blocks.text: Our Team of ProfessionalsAt Serenity House, we are proud of our experienced team of professionals who are dedicated to helping clients achieve and maintain a long-term recovery from addiction. Our team includes physicians, psychiatrists, psychotherapists, specialized counsellors, and support staff who work together to provide a multi-disciplinary approach to treatment. Each team member has extensive knowledge of addiction, mental health, and related issues, as well as the compassion and empathy needed to help individuals on their journey towards healing. Our team believes that every individual has the potential to recover from addiction and lead a fulfilling life, and we are committed to providing the resources and support needed to help our clients reach their goals.

about_blocks.text: Our FacilitySerenity House’s facility is located on a beautiful property that provides a tranquil and healing environment for clients seeking addiction treatment. The facility is designed to offer a comfortable and safe space for clients, while also offering a range of amenities to support the healing process. Our clients have access to comfortable accommodations, nutritious meals, fitness facilities, and recreational spaces to support their physical health and well-being. Additionally, our facility offers a range of therapy rooms and group spaces to support the emotional and psychological needs of our clients. Our serene environment and extensive amenities help clients feel comfortable and supported as they begin their journey towards recovery.

about_blocks.text: Our Approach to AftercareAt Serenity House, we know that the journey towards recovery from addiction is an ongoing process that requires ongoing support and care. That’s why we offer a comprehensive aftercare program to support our clients as they transition back into their daily lives. Our aftercare program includes ongoing therapy and counselling sessions, support groups, and access to our team of professionals for continued support as needed. We also help our clients connect with community resources and support systems to ensure they have the resources needed to maintain their recovery over the long-term. Our approach to aftercare helps our clients build a solid foundation for their ongoing recovery journey and ensures they receive the support needed for success.

about_blocks.text: At Serenity House, people struggling with addiction can find a welcoming and supportive environment where they can address harmful substance use and regain control of their life. The center’s three-month residential treatment program is designed specifically for men and takes a holistic approach to recovery. This approach focuses on the individual’s physical and mental wellbeing and encourages healthy integration of body, mind, and spirit. Serenity House has been operating as a charitable, non-profit organization for over 50 years, helping people in Ottawa and surrounding areas. Thanks to a highly experienced staff team and a commitment to ethical, empathetic, and respectful practices, clients can expect top-notch support and guidance on their journey to sobriety.

about_blocks.text: With a vision to inspire people to create possibility in recovery, Serenity House’s primary mission is to help those who seek recovery to live fulfilling and productive lives. The center’s values reflect its client-centered approach, which places a high value on honesty, ethics, inclusivity, empathy, presence, and respect. At Serenity House, each resident is treated as an individual, with their unique needs taken into account in the creation of personalized treatment plans. Removing distractions is crucial, and people are encouraged to be present with one another, ensuring that they receive the necessary support from those who understand what they’re going through. Overall, Serenity House is a welcoming and supportive space for men seeking to overcome addiction and move towards lasting recovery.
